frames.text: An animated Black woman with short curly hair stands centered in an urban street scene at dusk. She wears a bright yellow sleeveless turtleneck top and high-waisted blue pants with black heels. Gold hoop earrings accent her look. The background shows a photorealistic city street with brick buildings, warm street lamps, parked cars, and a deep blue twilight sky. The composition creates strong leading lines toward the subject, with warm orange lighting contrasting against the cool blue sky.

The same animated woman continues walking forward toward the camera, now slightly closer in frame. Her posture shows confident forward motion with arms naturally at her sides. The urban nighttime setting remains consistent with glowing street lamps illuminating the wet cobblestone street. Brick apartment buildings with fire escapes line both sides. The contrast between her flat animated style and the photorealistic background creates a distinctive mixed-media aesthetic. Her shadow is visible on the ground.

The animated woman has moved closer to the camera, now shown from approximately mid-thigh up. Her facial features are more visible, showing a calm, confident expression. The yellow top and blue pants remain prominent against the warm-lit urban backdrop. The perspective emphasizes the narrow street corridor with buildings converging toward the blue evening sky. Street lamps continue to cast warm golden light on the wet pavement and building facades on both sides.
